institution: IIIT Sonepat (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Sonepat)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: Around 82% placement rate; 22 companies participated in a recent drive; recruiters include Adobe Systems, IBM, Paytm, Accolite, ION Trading; highest package reported at 42 LPA, average around 8-9 LPA.
Professors described as highly qualified, drawn from IITs, NITs, and even foreign universities; supportive in guiding both academics and career paths.
Despite being temporary, the transit campus (SBIT) has AC classrooms, projectors/smart boards, well-equipped labs, wifi, and a functional library.
Rated 4.0/5; curriculum structured with coding fundamentals in year one, moving to applied projects from year two onward.
300-acre permanent campus land allocated, with plans for full facilities including hostels, library, gymnasium, and sports grounds once construction completes.

key_negative_themes.notes: Currently operating from a transit campus (SBIT, Pallri, near Bahalgarh) rather than its own facility; girls' hostel is temporarily located at IIT Delhi Technopark for safety reasons.
Temporary setup limits fest culture to mainly one sports fest ('Agnito'); students report reduced enthusiasm for coding culture due to the transit environment.
Some students find the institute expensive relative to its status as a newer, still NIRF-unranked institute.
Food described as average, though supplemented by a 24/7 vending machine.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Honest review of IIIT Sonipat — running in transit campus SBIT, only one fest (sports fest Agnito) due to temporary setup
Worthy academics but quite expensive in money — transit campus impacts coding culture negatively, but professors are coordinating
82% of total students placed, 22 companies participated, recruiters include Adobe, IBM, Paytm; highest package 42 LPA, average 8-9 LPA
Very good infrastructure, wifi campus, canteen food tastes good, safe environment for girls with transportation service
In the mess, food served is average; 3 grounds for basketball, football, cricket; high-speed wifi via Jio Fibernet

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Sonepat is positive and fairly well-rounded, with strong placement outcomes and well-qualified faculty as clear strengths. Like several other newer IIITs, its main drawback is the lack of a permanent campus, currently operating from a transit facility, which dampens campus culture and coding community enthusiasm even though day-to-day academic amenities remain functional.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
